issue_description: Radar tensors initialized as zeros without loading available Ku reflectivity measurements; presence mask could remain True despite empty data.
correction_applied: Implemented _load_radar_volume accessing radar_radiometer/correctedReflectFactor_Ku, normalizing dBZ to [0,1], 3D trilinear interpolation to (1,16,32,32), and setting has_radar=True strictly when valid Ku data exists.
verification_evidence: test_01_radar_present_loads_real_data, test_02_radar_absent_has_false_mask; loaded SMP_AL022021_GMI_GPM_20210614123541 with 685 valid voxels, non-zero sum 120.81

issue_description: Loader only read precipitable_water, ignoring other ERA5 reanalysis fields.
correction_applied: Implemented canonical 6-channel environmental schema [pw, sst, msl, t2m, u10, v10] with explicit channel validity mask env_channel_mask (6,) in EnvEncoder.
verification_evidence: test_03_environmental_channel_order, env_encoder input channels=6 with channel-mask gating verified

issue_description: Only surfacePrecipitation loaded, ignoring convective and water path fields.
correction_applied: Implemented 4-channel GPROF schema [surfacePrecipitation, convectivePrecipitation, rainWaterPath, iceWaterPath] with gprof_channel_mask (4,) in GPROFEncoder.

issue_description: Arbitrary selection of first 2 TB_ variables from S1/S2 caused severe physical frequency/polarization mismatch across sensors.
correction_applied: Implemented SENSOR_PMW_CHANNEL_MAP defining explicit physical channels [~19V, ~19H, ~37V, ~85V] for SSMI, SSMIS, GMI, TMI, AMSR2, AMSRE, AMSUB, MHS, ATMS with pmw_channel_mask (4,).
verification_evidence: test_04_unsupported_pmw_channel_mapping, empirical audit across 7 instruments verified correct channel masking

issue_description: _resize_to_grid used unconstrained mean imputation, conflating missing pixels with true zero measurements and polluting statistics.
correction_applied: Implemented _resize_to_grid_with_mask preserving binary valid-pixel mask through spatial transformation; zeroing out invalid pixels post-interpolation.
verification_evidence: test_06_missing_pixels_preserve_mask; zero data at invalid mask positions verified

issue_description: Silent exception swallowing caused corrupt or missing containers to be marked valid.
correction_applied: Removed bare pass; implemented structured error logging (_record_error) and configurable strict_mode raising FileNotFoundError/RuntimeError on container read failures.

issue_description: Missing intensity (0.0), pressure (1010 hPa), and stage (UN=5) contributed directly to loss as valid targets.
correction_applied: Implemented intensity_mask, pressure_mask, and stage_mask (excluding UN/unknown); loss functions strictly multiply by mask and normalize by valid target count.

issue_description: Track prediction head was disconnected; future lat/lon not converted to physical targets or loss.
correction_applied: Preserved storm_latitude/storm_longitude in sample index; implemented tangent-plane eastward/northward displacement in km for +6h,+12h,+18h,+24h with longitude wrapping; connected to head_track and MultiTaskLoss.

issue_description: Model only processed single overpass with delta_t=0; temporal forecasting was simulated rather than real.
correction_applied: Implemented TCPRIMEDSequenceDataset grouping chronologically within storm boundaries; collate_sequence_batch returning (B,T,C,H,W), padding masks, and actual delta_t hours; TCGraphFormer flattening timesteps, encoding, causal transformer attention, and anchor gathering.

issue_description: Spatial graph edge features included 8 fabricated zero-padded dimensions falsely described as physical features.
correction_applied: Rebuilt edge attributes to 8 real geometric dimensions [dr, dtheta, sin(dtheta), cos(dtheta), r_u, r_v, |dr|, dist_uv] based on storm-centered km coordinates; removed all fabricated zero padding.
verification_evidence: node_coords_km buffer verified spanning [-250km, +250km], edge_dim=8 verified

issue_description: Tokens were created under torch.no_grad(), blocking all reconstruction gradients from reaching modality encoders.
correction_applied: Student tokens generated with autograd enabled; targets detached; masking applied only to valid modality tokens while keeping context tokens visible; non-zero encoder gradients recorded.
verification_evidence: test_18_mfm_gradients_update_encoders verified non-zero gradient norms across IR, PMW, GPROF, and fusion

issue_description: Supervised training initialized fresh random model without loading pretrained backbone.
correction_applied: Implemented load_pretrained_backbone with key/dimension matching and explicit validation reporting; summary records initialization provenance.
verification_evidence: test_20_pretrained_weights_loaded verified 254 backbone parameter tensors transferred

issue_description: Fine-tuning kept conflicting loss weights active and silently trained from scratch when checkpoints were missing.
correction_applied: Implemented create_task_specific_loss activating strictly the target objective; required valid base checkpoint unless --allow-scratch is explicit; enforced NIO regional TEST storm isolation.

issue_description: Metrics computed against unmasked missing values; overall accuracy used for 3% RI; train mean falsely called persistence.
correction_applied: Rewrote evaluate() in trainer with mask-aware MAE/RMSE/bias, stage Macro-F1/balanced accuracy, RI precision/recall/F1/FAR/PR metrics, and track km error; clearly separated Climatology from Persistence baselines.
